title: Bring manual /compact command to parity
objective: Replace Go's simplified /compact command with the TS-equivalent manual compaction entry point.
implementation_scope: Parse and pass custom compact instructions from /compact arguments.
Project messages after the latest compact boundary before compacting.
Try session-memory compaction first when there are no custom instructions and task_14 is available.
Route through reactive compact when a reactive-only mode equivalent is enabled.
Run microcompact before traditional compact using aligned semantics from task_07.
Return and persist CompactionResult via BuildPostCompactMessages.
Remove ordinary last-4 truncation fallback; keep only explicit emergency fallback if product policy requires it and label it as non-parity.
out_of_scope: Do not implement new slash-command parsing infrastructure.
Do not implement partial compaction selection UI; task_13 owns partial compaction internals.
acceptance_criteria: /compact custom instructions affect the compact prompt.
/compact on an already compacted history does not resummarize previous summaries.
Manual compact produces boundary, summary, attachments, hook results, and session persistence.
LLM compact failure surfaces a meaningful compact error instead of silently truncating to the last four messages.
risks: Task has several dependencies; if task_14 is not complete, implement session-memory call as a no-op capability check.
Changing fallback behavior may expose errors that were previously hidden.
dispatch_prompt: Rewrite Go /compact to use the full compaction service path: boundary projection, custom instructions, optional session memory, microcompact, hooks, attachments, and structured results.
